// Fixture for the inline style scan. The .txt extension keeps it out of Biome and tsc: it is read
// as text, never compiled. Each write below is one the scan must find.
const stage = document.getElementById("stage") as HTMLElement;
stage.style.display = "none";
stage.style.left += "px";
stage.style.backgroundColor = "red";
stage.style["opacity"] = "0.5";
stage.style['z-index'] = "2";
stage.style.setProperty("--stage-scale", String(2));
stage.style.removeProperty("transform");
stage.style.cssText = "top: 0";
stage.setAttribute("style", "top: 0");
stage.setAttribute('style', "top: 0");
Object.assign(stage.style, { top: "0" });
stage.innerHTML = `<span class="x" style="color: red">${stage.id}</span>`;
const url = "https://example.com/*not-a-comment*/"; stage.style.width = "1px";
const quoted = /["'`]/.test(url); stage.style.height = "2px";
stage.style.display = "";

// Reads, data objects and comments the scan must not report.
const hidden = stage.style.display !== "none";
const same = stage.style.left === "0px";
const request = { style: "bodies" };
if (request.style === "bodies") {
  request.style = "points";
}
const badge = { glyph: "x", style: "y" };
const label = `${badge.glyph}/${badge.style}`;
const style = "bodies";
const text = "stage.style.opacity = '1'";
const scale = getComputedStyle(stage).getPropertyValue("--stage-scale");
const selected = document.querySelector(`[style="display: none"]`);
// stage.style.display = "block";
/* stage.style.opacity = "1";
   stage.setAttribute("style", "color: red"); */
export { hidden, same, label, style, text, scale, quoted, selected };
